cases.refreshed: Our One-on-One Reading Tutor for Kids provides students in grades K-3 with an opportunity to improve their reading skills by working one-on-one with a reading coach. Our reading coach creates a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers and helps children build confidence as readers. Our reading coach will listen to children read and provide support in phonics, sight words, and comprehension. Students can bring their favorite book or choose from the available selection at the Cambrian Branch Library to read aloud to their reading coach. Free. No advance registration is required. Sessions last 15 minutes and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. (A slightly longer session may be permitted, provided there are no other participants.) Participants can also use their session to read away their fines! Just inform your coach (open to youth only). Please note that the One-On-One Reading Tutor for Kids is a program to encourage young readers to practice their reading skills with an adult volunteer. (It is not intended as an hour-long tutoring session.)

events.title: Đọc truyện song ngữ & Thủ công | Bilingual Storytime & Craft

cases.refreshed: Giờ đọc truyện song ngữ Anh-Việt được tổ chức tại Thư Viện Evergreen, 2635 Aborn Road, San Jose, nhằm thúc đẩy các hoạt động đọc viết sớm qua các câu chuyện, bài hát, múa ca và vận động cơ thể. Chương trình này dành cho trẻ em ở mọi lứa tuổi cùng với cha mẹ hoặc người chăm sóc trẻ! Sau phần kể chuyện, các bé sẽ được hướng dẫn làm một món thủ công đơn giản và sáng tạo để mang về nhà! Hoàn toàn miễn phí, không cần đăng ký trước. Bilingual Storytime in English and Vietnamese, hosted by Evergreen Branch Library, will promote early literacy with stories, songs, fingerplay and movement activities. This program is geared for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers! Following the Storytime, kids will learn to make a simple and creative craft to take home! Free, no registration is required.

cases.refreshed: Middle and high schoolers: Come explore the TeenHQ Maker Space! Up to 5 teens at a time can use our 3D printers, Poster Printer, Glow Forge, Sewing & Serger Machines, Cricut, Button Press, and miscellaneous craft supplies. Work with our teen librarian to bring your idea to life. Equipment and materials have limits and time requirements. Pre-registration is recommended to reserve your spot. If registered participants have not arrived by 4:30 PM, their spots will be given to those waiting. All services are provided for free to middle and high school students (grades 6-12). Younger people and adults are not permitted in the area unless required to assist with a disability. Pre-registration will start 1 week before the start of the program. Please cancel your registration if you can no longer attend. Registration closes 1 hour before the start of the program. There will not be a waitlist for pre-registration. Drop-ins will be accepted if not all registration slots are filled and if not all registered individuals arrive by 4:30 PM. The area is wheelchair accessible from the Children's Room elevator. Other accommodations can be made available upon request. Please note that each device requires time to set up, use, and complete whatever task you're wanting to use the space for. Be sure that you have enough time in your schedule to attend the program. Not all tasks may be completed before the end of the program and you may need to return to get your completed items or pause your task and restart at another studio session. We appreciate your patience and flexibility. 3D Printing: All requested prints must take less than 4.5 hours to print. All requested prints will need to be picked up at a later date. Contact information is required for notification of pick-up. 3D print quality and the time needed to complete prints are not guaranteed. Multiple objects can be printed as long as the total time does not exceed 4.5 hours. Poster Printing: All prints must be assembled on a 2"x3" canvas and printed as a PNG file. Please see the regularly scheduled poster printing event for further details. One poster per teen per day. Glow Forge: Create a custom engraved object. Object should follow similar guidelines to the Custom Keychain Program. Complexity of request is at the discretion of the librarian. Sewing & Serger Machines: It is recommended that you bring your own fabric and thread if fabric is special or color is a factor. Scrap material and thread are available, but we cannot guarantee material quality or availability. An iron and ironing board are also available. Cricut: Basic Cricut supplies are available, such as construction and cardstock paper. If your project is specialized, such as requiring iron-on, you'll need to bring your own materials. It is recommended that you know the requirements for any materials you provide. Button Press: TeenHQ offers two sizes of button presses. We cannot offer printing. If you bring your own printout of buttons, it must be printed on standard printer paper. Paper thicker than standard printer paper cannot be used on the button presses. All measurements below are diameters in inches. Small Button Press: 1.25"; Large Button Press: 2.25"; Picture Size: 1.156"; Cut Line: 1.629"; Picture Size: 2.063"; Cut Line: 2.625".
